'''Marshak''' was a friend of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. He was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and tricked [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], misinforming him of the true nature of the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]].
